evals.name: local-edit-trim-subs
evals.prompt: Take evals/video-studio/media/source_clip.mp4 and make a 5-second clip from the start. Burn in the subtitles from evals/video-studio/media/captions.srt, and make sure the audio does not cut off abruptly at the end. Give me the final mp4.
assertions: Produces a final mp4 approximately 5 seconds long
Final video retains a 1280x720 video stream and an audio stream
Subtitles from captions.srt are burned in or attached as a caption track
Applies an audio fade near the cut boundary
Creates and validates a render manifest
Runs QA on the final video

evals.name: web-to-video
evals.prompt: Turn evals/video-studio/media/dashboard.html into a vertical short video, 1080x1920, about 6 seconds, suitable for posting as a Reel. Capture it with a headless browser, not screen recording.
assertions: Final video duration is approximately 6 seconds
Uses Playwright or headless Chromium capture, not screen recording
Creates and validates a render manifest

evals.name: platform-package-douyin
evals.prompt: Make a Douyin short-form package from evals/video-studio/media/source_clip.mp4. It should be vertical 9:16, under 10 seconds, with a cover image and the title '产品上线'. Give me a handoff package ready to publish, but do not upload anything anywhere.
assertions: Produces a vertical 1080x1920 final video under 10 seconds long
Builds a publish or handoff package and does not upload
Creates/validates a render manifest and runs QA
